column7: A church Deacon with his family who lived here & ministered in the Anglican Church at Jaure passed on. The wife and her family continue to reside here after his death.

Also this site was Jaure's first old village. It was called "Wibi." When the population of the people were dying related to sorcery and magic practices, the people migrated to their next location "Anei." and later settled again at Jaure's current village. The name "Jaure" refers to pine trees in Jaure language.

Jaure airstrip has been closed for quite a long time after 1993. According to one source who grew up at Jaure, there was a flight that came and circled above the airstrip after it was cleared but never landed. Even after that there were no other flights that landed. That same year, the same aircraft circled above Aiyari airstrip but never landed too.
Marase Elementary School is established at Aguido Primary School & not Marase.
Suari Elementary School is located in Jaure and not in Suari. It was established before the Primary that was moved from Aiyari to Jaure in 2024.

Suari Primary School is located in Jaure and not in Suari. It was moved from Aiyari to Jaure in 2024. In 2025 the two school buildings in bush materials were erected and this year students attended classes. The 2 in one building is partly in use. One half of the classroom is incomplete from the inside and not in use, while the other half of the building is completed and used by grade 5 students.
